CS 168
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
（印：C. I. D. HEADQUARTERS FILE No. CS 168 Date 9/12/30）
REPORT
No. 40 James Branch Station,
Date December 1, 1930.

Subject (in full) Unauthorised Chinese Invitation Card.

Made by ______ and Forwarded by ______

Sir,
On Friday, November 28th 1930 Mr. C. S. Sung of Tung Tai Shing
( ) approached the undersigned stating that he was giving
a dinner to celebrate the 1st of his son's birth (one month old), which
is the usual Chinese custom. I understood from the person that
the dinner would be held at his home and not at any Tea
Restaurant, neither Dance Hall, and that no invitation cards were
to be issued, therefore I did not think it necessary to forward
the usual application for permission. About 50 persons attended
including about 20 Chinese detectives, the remainder being the
person's relatives. The total cost of the dinner was $67.20.
Had I known that invitation cards were to be issued
and the dinner held in a public place, I would certainly have
forwarded the usual application.

I am, Sir,
Yours obediently,
[Signature]

（左侧批注：O. M. In future give such matters your attention as they occur. Confirming 8/12/30）

C.I.D.S 815

Sir,
In future such matters
will receive my personal
attention.
[Signature] 8/12/30.

CS 168
上海公共租界工部局警务处。
（印章：刑事侦缉处总部档案编号 CS 168 日期 1930年12月9日）
报告
第40号 詹姆斯捕房分署，
日期 1930年12月1日。

事由（全称） 未经授权的中文请柬。

由 ______ 制作并由 ______ 转呈

先生：
1930年11月28日（星期五），同泰盛（音译）的宋先生（C. S. Sung）接洽卑职，称其将为庆祝儿子出生满月（按中国习俗举办满月酒）而设宴。卑职从该人处获悉，宴席将在其家中举行，而非在任何茶楼或舞厅，且不发放请柬，因此卑职认为无需按惯例提交许可申请。约有50人出席，其中包括约20名华籍侦探，其余为该人的亲属。宴席总费用为67.20元。
若卑职早知将发放请柬且在公共场所举办宴席，定当按惯例提交申请。

此致，
敬礼
[签名]

（左侧批注：O. M. 今后此类事项发生时请予以关注。确认于 1930年12月8日）

C.I.D.S 815

先生：
今后此类事项
将由本人亲自
关注。
[签名] 1930年12月8日。
